    SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") AS total_selling_px,
    AVG(l."loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate,
    SUM((t."qty_sold(kg)" / (1 - l."loss_rate_%" / 100) - t."qty_sold(kg)") * w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS total_loss,

GROUP BY c.category_name, year
LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_sales_trading.main.veg_loss_rate_df WHERE "loss_rate_%" IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_sales_trading.main.veg_whsle_df WHERE "whsle_px_rmb-kg" IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_sales_trading.main.veg_txn_df WHERE "qty_sold(kg)" IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_sales_trading.main.veg_txn_df t LEFT JOIN bank_sales_trading.main.veg_whsle_df w ON t.item_code = w.item_code AND t.txn_date = w.whsle_date WHERE w.item_code IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_sales_trading.main.veg_txn_df t LEFT JOIN bank_sales_trading.main.veg_loss_rate_df l ON t.item_code = l.item_code WHERE l.item_code IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_sales_trading.main.veg_txn_df t LEFT JOIN bank_sales_trading.main.veg_cat c ON t.item_code = c.item_code WHERE c.item_code IS NULL;

SELECT 
    c.category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t.txn_date AS DATE)) AS year,
    ROUND(AVG(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS avg_whsle_px,
    ROUND(MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS max_whsle_px,
    ROUND(MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS min_whsle_px,
    ROUND(MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS whsle_px_diff,
    ROUND(SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" / (1 - l."loss_rate_%" / 100) * w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS total_whsle_px,
    ROUND(SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg"), 2) AS total_selling_px,
    ROUND(AVG(l."loss_rate_%"), 2) AS avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(SUM((t."qty_sold(kg)" / (1 - l."loss_rate_%" / 100) - t."qty_sold(kg)") * w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS total_loss,
    ROUND(SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") - SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" / (1 - l."loss_rate_%" / 100) * w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS profit
FROM bank_sales_trading.main.veg_txn_df t
JOIN bank_sales_trading.main.veg_whsle_df w ON t.item_code = w.item_code AND t.txn_date = w.whsle_date
JOIN bank_sales_trading.main.veg_loss_rate_df l ON t.item_code = l.item_code
JOIN bank_sales_trading.main.veg_cat c ON t.item_code = c.item_code
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t.txn_date AS DATE)) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
GROUP BY c.category_name, year
ORDER BY year, c.category_name;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_sales_trading.main.veg_whsle_df w LEFT JOIN bank_sales_trading.main.veg_txn_df t ON w.item_code = t.item_code AND w.whsle_date = t.txn_date WHERE t.item_code IS NULL;
